al-devpanel, docked

A short page with the panel as the body's last child, where Alder renders it: the panel docks to the bottom of the window, whatever the page's height, and the grip grows it upward.

The main demo (demo/devpanel.html) embeds panels in the page instead, where they stay in the flow.
